content.short: CardanoBI is an open-source business intelligence API layer for Cardano data, analytics, and app tools.
content.description: CardanoBI is an open-source business intelligence and API layer for Cardano data. The project organizes blockchain information into core network data, business intelligence outputs, and partner datasets so developers, analysts, and ecosystem projects can build data-driven services. Instead of forcing teams to parse raw chain activity themselves, CardanoBI provides structured access to accounts, blocks, transactions, contracts, pools, and derived analytics that can support dashboards, reporting, and application features.
content.meta: CardanoBI provides open-source API and analytics infrastructure for Cardano data and apps. Explore CardanoBI on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
